Priority Instructions

Minor: Routine service or general question, PM > not affecting immediate business or patient needs


Major: Operational but degraded > sense of urgency to work quickly so as not to disrupt patient/business flows.


Critical: Account down and/or FST on site.


Patient on Table: Highest alert. Potentially a life-threatening situation. “All hands on deck” required at all support levels; immediate attention is essential. Resolution within established milestones is imperative.
